scope: Thirteen installed tasks. Selection counts and later confirmation outcomes are separate; this is not a claim that all thirteen currently qualify at 0/3.

comparison_scope.note: The three imported tasks are not part of the completed five-model comparison.

finite-layer-phoresis.review: All three fitted viscosity and passed calibration, parameter recovery and no-slip anchors. They retained the no-slip force-transmission weight with a slip drag factor, and failed the three slip-sensitive prediction groups.

hierarchical-glass-overlaps.review: All three fitted width and retained the starter parent/descendant product law. Calibration, parameter and parent-collision checks passed; the five state/joint partition groups failed.

insulating-mhd-duct.review: All three fitted viscosity and retained the starter uncoupled component current closure. Calibration and parameter recovery passed; all three oblique-field prediction groups failed.

ring-current-fluctuations.review: All three fitted diffusivity but retained the homogeneous quadratic current SCGF. Calibration and exact-limit anchors passed; both strong-field prediction groups failed.

single-file-memory.review: All three fitted diffusivity but retained the stationary-increment covariance. Calibration and diagonal anchors passed; all three unequal-time ratio groups failed.
